recent.text: Nic Claxton, who dealt with muscle strain (hamstring) for 1st time in career: “I feel great. I’m excited to get back. . . . I take a lot of pride in not being injured, being available. To have an injury in camp with a new team is frustrating. But I’m ready to run through a wall.”
